lore.common: Keeps everyone waiting at the gate, then leaves ten minutes early when they're in the café.
lore.uncommon: Draws long white lines across the blue sky, and never finishes the picture.
lore.rare: Sent everybody's suitcase to a different country, and kept the socks.
lore.epic: Took off so loudly that every car alarm in the airport car park joined in.
lore.legendary: Flew round the whole world in a single day, then landed and asked why everyone looked so tired.

names.legendary: Old Kitty Kestrel, Ace of the Fair

lore.common: Coughs and splutters on every take-off, so the farmer's cows lie down in protest.
lore.uncommon: Has two sets of wings, in case it loses one, it says.
lore.rare: Looped the loop so close to the haystack that it blew the scarecrow's hat off.
lore.epic: Flew upside down over the county show and every spectator's ice cream fell on their shoes.
lore.legendary: Flew under every bridge on the river in one afternoon, and still landed in time for tea.

lore.common: Hangs around on the airfield all morning waiting for someone else to pull it into the air.
lore.uncommon: Has no engine at all, so it floats so quietly that birds fly alongside to check it's real.
lore.rare: Circled up a warm air bubble so high that it ended up above the clouds.
lore.epic: Circled silently over the beach all afternoon, and every seagull thought it was a giant gull and followed it home.
lore.legendary: Stayed up riding warm air for a whole week. When it finally landed, the pilot had grown a beard and the airfield had a new café.

names.legendary: Major Whoosh, Ace of the Bedroom

lore.common: Is flown round the living room with loud whooshing noises until it crashes into the dog.
lore.uncommon: Has a little plastic pilot who hasn't blinked in ten years.
lore.rare: Fired its spring-loaded missile across the room and knocked the biscuit off the plate.
lore.epic: Fought a dogfight with every toy plane in the house, and the curtains were badly injured.
lore.legendary: Was flown in a thousand imaginary missions, crashed in nine hundred, and still has both wings.

lore.common: Lands on the lake right where the ducks were having their meeting.
lore.uncommon: Has floats for feet, so it wobbles about on the water like a duck on stilts.
lore.rare: Hopped from lake to lake all day, delivering post to cabins with no roads.
lore.epic: Landed in the bay so splashily that every sailing boat got a free wash.
lore.legendary: Landed on the hotel swimming pool to deliver a birthday cake. The guests kept swimming round its floats as if it were a lilo.

names.legendary: Commander Starlite of the Bunk Bed

lore.common: Counts down from ten every time you pick it up, then refuses to launch.
lore.uncommon: Has wobbly plastic fins that never stand up straight on the shelf.
lore.rare: Launched off the bunk bed and landed in the laundry basket, mission complete.
lore.epic: Blasted off from the garden with one stamp on the air pump and landed on the school roof. The caretaker now keeps a ladder ready.
lore.legendary: Pumped so hard it flew over three gardens and the school, then landed back in its own toy box. Its owner calls this a full orbit.

lore.common: Wails its siren just as you're about to fall asleep, then turns round the next corner.
lore.uncommon: Writes its name backwards on the front so other drivers can read it in their mirror.
lore.rare: Parted a traffic jam just by flashing its blue lights, like a magic trick.
lore.epic: Turned on its siren once at the seaside, and every gull on the beach copied it until sunset.
lore.legendary: Got across the busiest city in the world in ten minutes, and the patient had only a splinter.

lore.common: Roars its burner right above your head at six in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Floats wherever the wind takes it, so it never knows where it will land.
lore.rare: Landed in a field of sheep, and the sheep followed it for a mile.
lore.epic: Floated over the city with a hundred other balloons, and everyone went to work late.
lore.legendary: Floated so high over the mountains that it landed on a summit, and the climbers who had walked up for a week were not pleased.

lore.common: Leaves a hot black road behind it that smells like a burnt pancake.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a road so warm behind it that every cat in the street comes to lie on it at teatime.
lore.rare: Laid a brand new road down the street in one day, and everyone's car was stuck at home.
lore.epic: Paved every pothole in town in one night, and the cyclists cried with happiness.
lore.legendary: Laid a road so smooth from coast to coast that drivers could hear their own tyres purring.

lore.common: Pushes the same pile of dirt back and forth all day as if it lost something.
lore.uncommon: Lowers its big blade like a grumpy face whenever someone walks past.
lore.rare: Pushed a skip, a shed and the foreman's lunch into the same pile before noticing anyone was shouting.
lore.epic: Cleared a whole building site in one morning, and the workers had to find something else to do.
lore.legendary: Moved a mountain one push at a time, and the mountain now lives two miles further down the valley.

lore.common: Smooths out the gravel road, then leaves a little ridge right in the middle for you to bump over.
lore.uncommon: Has its blade in the middle of its body, like a giant with a belt buckle.
lore.rare: Dug a ditch along the whole lane so neatly that the rainwater ran away with a grin.
lore.epic: Smoothed out every dirt road in the county so well that the farmers' eggs stopped breaking.
lore.legendary: Cleared a mountain pass of snow with one sweep of its blade, then left a perfectly neat snowman at the top.

lore.common: Rolls over the same bit of road a hundred times as if it hasn't noticed.
lore.uncommon: Moves so slowly that pigeons walk beside it to keep it company.
lore.rare: Flattened the fresh tarmac so smooth that skateboarders queued to try it.
lore.epic: Rolled over a forgotten garden hose and sprayed the whole street like a giant fountain until teatime.
lore.legendary: Rolled out a playground so flat that every marble in it has stayed exactly where it was dropped.

lore.common: Spins on the spot like it's dancing, then scoops up the wrong pile.
lore.uncommon: Swaps its bucket for forks, a brush or a drill in seconds, and swaps just to show off.
lore.rare: Fit through a garden gate that every other digger was too big for.
lore.epic: Moved a whole hill of sand in one afternoon, and the beach volleyball club moved in.
lore.legendary: Did the work of ten bigger diggers in one week, then fitted back into its tiny garage.

lore.common: Puffs clouds of steam over the hedge and makes the washing on the line smell smoky.
lore.uncommon: Has a huge iron roller at the front that clanks like an old kettle.
lore.rare: Whistled so loudly at the village green that the cricketers dropped the ball.
lore.epic: Steamed up the whole village green so thickly that the fête carried on in fog, and three people bought the same cake twice.
lore.legendary: Rolled flat a road made entirely of conkers so the village could have a smooth autumn. The squirrels have not forgiven it.

names.legendary: Big Shovelina, Queen of the Quarry

lore.common: Scoops up a huge bucket of gravel and drops half of it on the way to the lorry.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its bucket high like it's showing off a trophy.
lore.rare: Filled a lorry with one scoop, and the lorry sagged on its springs.
lore.epic: Moved every gravel pile in the quarry in one day, and the quarry manager spent the evening looking for his car under one.
lore.legendary: Built a gravel mountain so tall that the quarry workers put a flag on top.

lore.common: Pulls away from the stop just as you reach it, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Hisses and kneels down at every stop like it's bowing to the passengers.
lore.rare: Fit forty schoolchildren, two dogs and a tuba on board, and still had room for a pram.
lore.epic: Took a wrong turn on the school trip and brought forty children to the zoo instead of the museum. Nobody has complained.
lore.legendary: Ran its route for fifty years without being late once, and the clock tower sets its time by it.

lore.common: Beeps its horn in the car park just to say hello to other cars.
lore.uncommon: Can never find a parking space near the shop, and always parks crooked.
lore.rare: Packed a whole family, a tent and a dog into its boot for a camping trip.
lore.epic: Got stuck in the biggest traffic jam ever and played the radio so loud that everyone sang along.
lore.legendary: Drove a million miles in one lifetime and still has the same fluffy dice hanging from its mirror.

lore.common: Rolls through the only puddle in the car park and splashes your clean trousers.
lore.uncommon: Has a shiny hubcap that it keeps losing in the hedge.
lore.rare: Rolled off the car on a hill and overtook the car on the way down.
lore.epic: Got stuck in a giant puddle at the roundabout and sent a wave over every car going round, twice.
lore.legendary: Did a million turns without a single puncture, and the garage gave it a gold hubcap. It lost it in a hedge the same day.

names.legendary: Calipra, Who Stopped the Runaway Bus

lore.common: Squeals loudly every time the car stops at the lights, so everyone turns to look.
lore.uncommon: Gets so hot after driving down a hill that you could warm your hands on it.
lore.rare: Stopped a speeding car so quickly that the shopping slid onto the front seat.
lore.epic: Stopped so suddenly at the zebra crossing that every car behind stopped too, all the way back to the next town.
lore.legendary: Stopped a runaway bus on the steepest hill in town, and the passengers clapped.

lore.common: Drips a little petrol on your shoe after every fill-up.
lore.uncommon: Ticks up the price so fast that it looks like it's racing.
lore.rare: Clicked off at exactly the wrong moment and left everyone in the queue grumbling.
lore.epic: Ran dry on the holiday weekend, and the queue of cars stretched past the motorway sign, the service station and a farm.
lore.legendary: Clicked off at exactly the round number for every customer for a whole summer, and drivers queued from three towns away to watch.

names.legendary: Sir Gleamsworth, Grin of the Highway

lore.common: Catches every bug on the motorway and keeps them as souvenirs.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a grinning face on the front of the car, especially when the headlights are on.
lore.rare: Glinted so brightly in the sun that the car behind had to put on sunglasses.
lore.epic: Breathed in so hard through its slats on the motorway that it swallowed a kite, three crisp packets and somebody's sun hat.
lore.legendary: Grinned at a grumpy traffic jam until every driver grinned back, and the jam cleared itself out of embarrassment.

lore.common: Clip-clops down the lane at its own pace, and the cars behind have to wait.
lore.uncommon: Carries a load of hay so high that the driver can't see over it.
lore.rare: Bounced over the cobbles so hard that all the apples fell out at once.
lore.epic: Took the wrong lane at market and led every car in town round the duck pond twice at walking pace.
lore.legendary: Carried a whole wedding party across the flooded ford without a single wet shoe, and the horse got the first slice of cake.

names.legendary: Grandad Tin, the First on the Road

lore.common: Needs a crank turned at the front to start, and kicks back at anyone who does it wrong.
lore.uncommon: Only comes in black, and is quite proud of it.
lore.rare: Putt-putted through the town so loudly that the horses all looked up from their hay.
lore.epic: Drove the dusty road from one town to the next, and the dust cloud reached the next county.
lore.legendary: Was driven home from the museum by mistake and did the school run for a week before anyone noticed.

names.legendary: Grand Ox Wagon of the Valley

lore.common: Creaks so loudly on every turn of its wheel that the birds fly off.
lore.uncommon: Goes at the speed of a walking ox, which is the slowest speed there is.
lore.rare: Got stuck in the mud and pulled itself out with one heave from the ox.
lore.epic: Carried the whole village's harvest in one trip, and nobody's barn had any room left.
lore.legendary: Arrived so late at the harvest fair that it became the first cart at next year's fair. The ox calls this planning.

lore.common: Locks tight every time you lean forward to reach the radio.
lore.uncommon: Twists itself into a knot every time you put it on.
lore.rare: Clicked shut so firmly that the dog couldn't escape, even for a sausage.
lore.epic: Locked every passenger into the coach at once, and the driver finally had peace.
lore.legendary: Has kept millions of people safe without ever once being thanked by name.

lore.common: Keeps its drum spinning even when it's parked, like it's afraid to stop.
lore.uncommon: Pours wet concrete everywhere except where it's supposed to go.
lore.rare: Mixed a load so thick that a builder's wellie is still stuck in the new path.
lore.epic: Poured the foundations for a whole street in one day, and the street's footprints are now permanent.
lore.legendary: Poured the concrete for the biggest bridge in the country, and still had enough left to make a paddling pool.

lore.common: Lifts the worker up to the street light, then gets stuck halfway down.
lore.uncommon: Can reach the top of a three-storey house without leaving the pavement.
lore.rare: Rescued a kitten from the top of a tree, and the kitten wanted to go up again.
lore.epic: Changed every light bulb on the high street in one night, and the town shone like Christmas.
lore.legendary: Reached the clock tower to fix the clock and turned the hands back an hour, so the whole town got a lie-in it never asked for.

lore.common: Swings its hook right past the office window just as someone is drinking their coffee.
lore.uncommon: Stretches its long arm into the sky and wobbles a bit when the wind blows.
lore.rare: Lifted a whole swimming pool onto a hotel roof without spilling a drop.
lore.epic: Swung a steel beam round the city skyline, and every pigeon moved to a new roof.
lore.legendary: Built the tallest tower in the city one beam at a time, then folded itself up and drove away.

lore.common: Beeps the whole time it goes up, the whole time it goes down, and a little bit after.
lore.uncommon: Folds up and down like a concertina, and squeaks on every fold.
lore.rare: Lifted a painter so high that he painted the ceiling and the light fitting by mistake.
lore.epic: Rose up to every shelf in the warehouse in one night, and every box was put away.
lore.legendary: Raised a dancer so high in the school play that she finished the dance on the theatre roof, to cheers from the pigeons.

lore.common: Leaves a trail of gravel along every road it drives down.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its back up and pours everything out with a long, satisfied rumble.
lore.rare: Tipped its load on the wrong drive, and a family came home to a mountain of gravel where their car used to be.
lore.epic: Dumped so many loads at the quarry in one day that a new hill appeared on the horizon.
lore.legendary: Moved enough earth in one year to build a whole island in the bay, and the seagulls moved straight in.

names.legendary: Dig-Dig Doris, Busy at Both Ends

lore.common: Digs a hole at one end and fills it in at the other, so nothing ever changes.
lore.uncommon: Has a bucket at the front and a digger at the back, and can't decide which way to face.
lore.rare: Dug a trench down the whole street to lay a pipe, and found a lost garden gnome.
lore.epic: Dug up every road in town for repairs at the same time, and nobody could drive anywhere.
lore.legendary: Dug holes with one end and planted trees with the other all down the high street in one night. The town woke up in a forest.

names.legendary: Big Diggory, Who Dug the Canal

lore.common: Digs a big hole right outside your window at seven in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Scratches its own back with its bucket, and sometimes uses it to wave at the crane.
lore.rare: Scooped up a whole tree, roots and all, and planted it on the other side of the road.
lore.epic: Dug the foundations for a whole shopping centre in one week, and the hole looked like a canyon.
lore.legendary: Dug a canal from one town to the next, and the ducks now swim there for their holidays.

names.legendary: Engine Number One, Hero of Ash Street

lore.common: Fills its tank at the hydrant and soaks the firefighter holding the hose, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Its ladder stretches so high that it can wave to people on the top floor.
lore.rare: Sprayed its hose so hard that it knocked the leaves off every tree in the street.
lore.epic: Raced through the city with every light flashing, and the traffic parted like a river.
lore.legendary: Put out a bonfire, a burning barbecue and a birthday cake in one afternoon, and the birthday boy has never forgiven it.

lore.common: Crashes the bins about at six in the morning so nobody can sleep in.
lore.uncommon: Squashes everything in its back with a big grinding crunch.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole sofa in one go, then asked for more.
lore.epic: Crunched the whole festival's rubbish in one night, including the stage, two tents and the mayor's deckchair.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a wedding ring by mistake, then crunched through a whole mountain of rubbish to give it back before the cake was cut.

names.legendary: Ranger Rumble, King of the Trails

lore.common: Spits mud on everyone behind it, especially if they're wearing white.
lore.uncommon: Bounces over every bump on the trail, so the rider's teeth rattle.
lore.rare: Climbed a hill so steep that the goats stood back and watched.
lore.epic: Raced through the forest trails so fast that every deer looked up at once.
lore.legendary: Crossed every muddy field in the county in one day and came home so muddy that the farmer planted potatoes on it.

lore.common: Kicks up sand all over the picnic blanket every time it goes past.
lore.uncommon: Has big chunky tyres and no doors, so you climb in over the side.
lore.rare: Jumped off a sand dune and landed so softly that the seagulls clapped.
lore.epic: Raced along the whole beach at low tide, and the sandcastles had to be rebuilt.
lore.legendary: Drove across the biggest desert in the world and came back with only a little sand in its seat.

lore.common: Bumps into everyone on the track and says it was the steering.
lore.uncommon: Is so low to the ground that you can feel every pebble.
lore.rare: Took the corner so tight that it overtook three karts on the inside.
lore.epic: Started a bumper chase round the track that ended with every kart in the hay bales.
lore.legendary: Drove so many laps one summer that it came round again before its own tyre smoke had cleared, and overtook itself.

lore.common: Roars through the farmyard and scatters the chickens every morning.
lore.uncommon: Rounds up the sheep faster than the sheepdog, which isn't happy about it.
lore.rare: Bashed the gate open with its front rack and didn't stop to close it.
lore.epic: Raced across every field on the farm towing a trailer of hay, and left a trail so long that the cows followed it into the farmhouse kitchen.
lore.legendary: Rounded up a thousand sheep in one morning, then did it all again because the sheepdog wanted another go.

lore.common: Leaves enormous muddy tyre prints all the way down the lane, so everyone knows exactly where it went for lunch.
lore.uncommon: Has four huge wheels all the same size, so it looks like it's on tiptoes.
lore.rare: Pulled a plough so wide that it finished the whole field in four turns.
lore.epic: Rolled into the village fête and towed the bouncy castle, the tea tent and the tombola to the next field when it rained.
lore.legendary: Pulled a stuck lorry, a stuck bus and a stuck tractor out of the same ditch in one afternoon.

lore.common: Hovers over the garden just as you hang the washing out, and blows it all over the street.
lore.uncommon: Lands on a big painted H and refuses to land anywhere without one, even on the beach.
lore.rare: Landed on the hospital roof so gently that the patients didn't spill their tea.
lore.epic: Hovered over the zoo for a news report, and every parrot learned to say whup-whup-whup.
lore.legendary: Rescued a lost sheep from a cliff ledge in a storm, and the sheep still won't stop bleating about it.

names.legendary: Grand Banneria, Tallest on the Green

lore.common: Clangs its rope against the pole all night when the wind blows, ting-ting-ting.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its flag so loudly in a storm that it sounds like applause.
lore.rare: Was the only thing still standing after the gale, with its flag pointing straight out.
lore.epic: Flew a flag so big over the town square that it shaded the whole market.
lore.legendary: Flew a flag so high on the school's birthday that a passing airliner dipped its wings, and the whole school waved back.

names.legendary: Old Reaper Reggie of the Wheat

lore.common: Blocks the country lane for miles while it crawls along at walking pace.
lore.uncommon: Has a long spout that pours grain into the trailer, and sometimes into the farmer's hat.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole row of wheat in one go and spat out the straw neatly behind it.
lore.epic: Harvested every field in the county under the full moon, and the farmers had breakfast early.
lore.legendary: Harvested a field in the shape of a giant smiley face, and airline pilots now wave at it on their way past.

names.legendary: Golden Bale, Pillow of the Farm

lore.common: Gets into your socks, your hair and your sandwich, and itches for the rest of the day.
lore.uncommon: Is rolled into giant round bales that farmers stack like cotton reels.
lore.rare: Rolled down the hill on its own and knocked over the farm gate.
lore.epic: Toppled off the trailer at the crossroads, and the whole village had to stop and help.
lore.legendary: Was rolled into a bale so big that the farm used it as a guest house for a family of mice, two hens and a very lazy dog.

names.legendary: Old Ironface, Guardian of the Sewers

lore.common: Clunks loudly every time a car drives over it, day and night.
lore.uncommon: Lets out little puffs of steam on cold mornings, as if it's breathing.
lore.rare: Rattled so much under a lorry that it popped up and danced on the road.
lore.epic: Was lifted for an inspection, and every tennis ball lost in the last fifty years bounced up out of the sewer onto the street.
lore.legendary: Was so heavy that the strongest man in town tried to lift it, and it lifted him instead. It still has his handprint.

lore.common: Wobbles so much on the motorway that the cups in the cupboard rattle all the way.
lore.uncommon: Has tiny curtains in every window that the owners close as soon as anyone looks.
lore.rare: Hit a pothole so hard that every cupboard opened and the breakfast cereal ended up in the shower.
lore.epic: Got stuck in the gateway of the campsite, so the whole family had their holiday right there in the lane.
lore.legendary: Stayed at the campsite so long that the town gave it a postcode, a postman and a bus stop outside.

lore.common: Stands in the gallery so that everyone bumps into its corner.
lore.uncommon: Holds up a statue all day without being thanked even once.
lore.rare: Held up such a heavy statue that it slowly sank into the floor.
lore.epic: Was put out by mistake without its statue, and visitors spent a month admiring the empty pedestal as modern art.
lore.legendary: Held up a statue so still for so long that the pigeons decided it was the safest roof in the city and moved in for good.

lore.common: Stands in the middle of the pavement so that people walking with phones bump into it.
lore.uncommon: Has been leaned on by so many people that it now leans a little itself.
lore.rare: Was used by a boy to vault over a stream, and it landed better than he did.
lore.epic: Held up so many festival lights that the high street could be seen from the next town, and moths came from three counties.
lore.legendary: Was bumped into by a hundred thousand people looking at their phones, and finally got a phone of its own to stare back at them.

names.legendary: Old Bulwark of the Castle Gate

lore.common: Clangs so loudly when it's dropped that the whole castle hears.
lore.uncommon: Has so many dents from old battles that you can see your face a dozen times in it.
lore.rare: Blocked an arrow so neatly that the archer asked for it back.
lore.epic: Was used as a sledge by every child in the castle, and reached the village at the bottom before the knights did.
lore.legendary: Bounced a catapulted cabbage back so hard that it landed in the enemy's soup, and the battle stopped for lunch.

lore.common: Rattles and shakes so hard in the barn that the dust gets into everyone's tea.
lore.uncommon: Blows clouds of chaff out of the barn door, and the sparrows love it.
lore.rare: Separated a whole cart of wheat in one hour and left a perfect pile of grain.
lore.epic: Threshed every farm's harvest in the valley in one week, and the mill ran day and night.
lore.legendary: Threshed so fast that the grain shot out through the barn roof, and the hens had breakfast delivered from the sky for a month.

names.legendary: Grand Spinner, Keeper of the Platform

lore.common: Locks just as you push through, and you bump into it with your tummy.
lore.uncommon: Eats your ticket and gives it back a second later with a click.
lore.rare: Spun so fast in the rush that it sent commuters onto the wrong platform, still holding their coffee.
lore.epic: Jammed at rush hour, and the whole station queued back up the stairs.
lore.legendary: Spun round so many times in one rush hour that it wound the station clock forward, and everyone got home early.

lore.common: Plays its jingle at the end of the street just when dinner is ready.
lore.uncommon: Hands out cones so fast that half the sprinkles miss.
lore.rare: Played its tune so sweetly that every child on the estate came out in slippers, even the ones in the bath.
lore.epic: Parked at the beach on the hottest day and the queue went all the way to the sea.
lore.legendary: Kept its freezer so cold in a heatwave that the penguins at the zoo asked to move in.

names.legendary: Commander Rugged of the Wild Track

lore.common: Drives through every puddle on the school run on purpose.
lore.uncommon: Has a spare wheel stuck on its back like a big round backpack.
lore.rare: Drove through a river so deep that fish swam past the windows.
lore.epic: Led a safari across the plains, and every giraffe stopped chewing to stare.
lore.legendary: Crossed a whole jungle without a road, and came out the other side with a parrot riding on the bonnet.

lore.common: Stops working just as you step on it, so it turns into a very tall staircase.
lore.uncommon: Its handrail moves slightly faster than the steps, so your arm slowly runs away.
lore.rare: Swallowed a shoelace at the top and kept the shoe as a souvenir. The lost property office is now mostly left shoes.
lore.epic: Ran backwards at the shopping centre and sent every shopper back to the ground floor.
lore.legendary: Has moved a billion people up and down at the station and never once climbed a single step itself.

names.legendary: Lady Throttle, Queen of the Highway

lore.common: Revs its engine at the traffic lights so loudly that the pigeons take off.
lore.uncommon: Pops a wheelie on the empty road, then pretends it was an accident.
lore.rare: Squeezed through a traffic jam so narrow that the cars had to breathe in.
lore.epic: Led a roaring parade of motorbikes along the coast road, and every seagull flew inland.
lore.legendary: Rode the longest road in the world from top to bottom, and arrived with the same fly still stuck to its visor.

names.legendary: Sir Sidesaddle of the Picnic Run

lore.common: Bounces its passenger over every bump while the rider gets the smooth seat.
lore.uncommon: Its passenger always wears goggles and a scarf, even to the corner shop.
lore.rare: Lifted right off the road going round a corner, and the passenger waved at everyone.
lore.epic: Rattled down every country lane on the picnic run, and the sandwiches were mostly crumbs.
lore.legendary: Carried a dog in goggles round the whole country, and the dog is now famous in every village.

lore.common: Always has something rattling around in the back that nobody can find.
lore.uncommon: Drops its tailgate for every picnic, barbecue and muddy football match.
lore.rare: Carried a sofa, a fridge and a goat home from market in one trip.
lore.epic: Pulled every stuck car out of the muddy field at the summer festival.
lore.legendary: Carried a whole barn across the valley one plank at a time in one weekend, and the cows inside never noticed.

lore.common: Turns on its siren just to get through the traffic lights, then turns it off again.
lore.uncommon: Flashes blue lights so bright that the whole street glows at night.
lore.rare: Turned on its lights to stop the traffic for a family of ducks, then escorted them all the way to the pond.
lore.epic: Chased a runaway goat through the whole town, and the goat won.
lore.legendary: Caught a runaway hot-air balloon by its rope and towed it gently back to the fair, with the passengers still waving.

lore.common: Points its little dish at the ceiling all day, waiting for a signal from the lampshade.
lore.uncommon: Has shiny gold foil wings that come off every time someone dusts it.
lore.rare: Spun round on its stand so fast that its solar panels flew across the classroom.
lore.epic: Was hung from the ceiling with a hundred others for the science fair, and the room became space.
lore.legendary: Beeped so convincingly during space week that the headteacher cancelled maths in case it was a real message from space.

names.legendary: Grand Wanderhome of the Open Road

lore.common: Drives along the coast road at its own pace, and fifty cars follow it like ducklings.
lore.uncommon: Pops its roof up at the campsite so it looks like it's surprised.
lore.rare: Parked in the best spot at the campsite and opened its awning over half the field.
lore.epic: Drove a family of six round the whole country, and nobody fought for more than a minute.
lore.legendary: Has visited every beach on the coast and still has the same sand in its door seals from the first trip.

names.legendary: Old Mabel, Slowest on the Water

lore.common: Chugs along the canal so slowly that the walkers on the towpath overtake it.
lore.uncommon: Waits at every lock for the water to rise, then waits a bit more.
lore.rare: Carried a load so heavy that it sank down to the waterline and the ducks walked on its deck.
lore.epic: Got stuck sideways in the canal and every boat behind it queued until sunset.
lore.legendary: Was so long that its front reached the next lock before its back had left the last one, and the lock keeper had to open both at once.

names.legendary: Little Skipper, Bravest of the Bay

lore.common: Tips over the moment anyone stands up, then floats there looking innocent.
lore.uncommon: Has a daggerboard that slides up and down, and it always slides up exactly when you need it down.
lore.rare: Sailed so close to the swans that it accidentally joined their family, and now gets fed bread every Sunday.
lore.epic: Raced at the regatta with fifty other dinghies, and all of them tipped over at the same buoy.
lore.legendary: Sailed across the whole bay with only a beach towel for a sail, and arrived before the ferry.

names.legendary: Grand Ferrina, Crosser of the Strait

lore.common: Blows its foghorn the moment you've finally balanced your tea on the rail.
lore.uncommon: Swallows cars into its belly and spits them out on the other side.
lore.rare: Rolled so much on a windy crossing that everyone's chips slid to one side of the café.
lore.epic: Carried a whole travelling funfair across the bay, and the big wheel kept turning for the entire crossing.
lore.legendary: Has crossed the same strait ten thousand times and never once forgotten anyone's car.

names.legendary: Captain Codsworth of the Morning Tide

lore.common: Is followed everywhere by a cloud of noisy seagulls hoping for scraps.
lore.uncommon: Drags its big nets along the bottom and comes back smelling of the sea.
lore.rare: Leaves the harbour before dawn and wakes up every house on the seafront.
lore.epic: Came back with so many fish that the whole town had fish and chips for a week.
lore.legendary: Caught a boot, a bicycle and a treasure chest in one net, and the treasure turned out to be somebody's old socks.

lore.common: Glides under every low bridge so close that the gondolier has to duck.
lore.uncommon: Is pushed along by a single long pole, and goes exactly where it's pointed.
lore.rare: Got its pole stuck in the mud, and the gondolier was left hanging on the pole while the gondola drifted off to dinner.
lore.epic: Led a parade of gondolas through the city at sunset, and every window opened.
lore.legendary: Has carried a thousand couples under the same old bridge and never once tipped anyone in.

names.legendary: Lady Driftwood, Home on the Water

lore.common: Bumps against the riverbank all night, so everyone inside sleeps with a little rock.
lore.uncommon: Has so many plant pots on its roof that it looks like a floating garden.
lore.rare: Came loose from its mooring and drifted to the next village before anyone woke up.
lore.epic: Grew so many tomatoes on its roof that the whole river had salad for a summer, and the ducks complained about the onions.
lore.legendary: Has been moored in the same spot for fifty years, and the ducks think it's part of the bank.

lore.common: Squeaks every time you sit in it, so everyone on the beach looks over.
lore.uncommon: Needs to be blown up with a pump for an hour before it'll go anywhere.
lore.rare: Sprang a tiny leak and slowly sank while everyone pretended not to notice.
lore.epic: Drifted out of the bay with a family of ducks on board, and the lifeguards rowed out to fetch it.
lore.legendary: Bounced over the biggest wave on the beach and came back with every child still inside.

lore.common: Slides down the slipway with a huge splash, soaking everyone watching from the pier.
lore.uncommon: Is painted bright orange so it can be seen through the thickest fog.
lore.rare: Rowed out into a storm that kept every other boat in the harbour.
lore.epic: Brought a whole ferry's worth of passengers back to the harbour in one night.
lore.legendary: Rowed out through a hurricane to rescue a stranded sailor, who turned out to be a very grateful seal.

names.legendary: Old Oarsworth of the Boating Lake

lore.common: Goes round in circles on the park lake every time you row with one oar.
lore.uncommon: Creaks and drips so much that you have to bail it out with your shoe.
lore.rare: Was rowed across the lake so fast that it overtook the swans.
lore.epic: Raced every boat on the boating lake at once, and everyone got splashed.
lore.legendary: Was hired for one hour by a very slow rower and came back three weeks later with a family of geese living in it.

lore.common: Leans over so far in the wind that the picnic slides off the deck.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its sail loudly when the wind changes, as if it's complaining.
lore.rare: Caught the wind so perfectly that it raced past every motorboat in the bay.
lore.epic: Caught a gust so big in the harbour that it towed three crab nets, a fishing line and a very surprised windsurfer out to sea.
lore.legendary: Sailed round the whole world without an engine, and came home with a postcard from every country stuck to its sail.

lore.common: Sinks to the bottom of the bath the moment you let go of it.
lore.uncommon: Pokes its little periscope out of the bubbles to spy on the rubber duck.
lore.rare: Dived under the bubbles and came up behind the boat like a sneak attack.
lore.epic: Explored every corner of the paddling pool, and the frogs moved out.
lore.legendary: Has been on a thousand bath-time voyages and still hasn't found the bottom of the plughole.

names.legendary: Tough Tilly, Strongest in the Harbour

lore.common: Puffs smoke from its chimney all day like it's huffing at everyone.
lore.uncommon: Is the smallest boat in the harbour but pulls the biggest ships.
lore.rare: Pushed a giant cargo ship into its berth with one gentle nudge.
lore.epic: Tooted so proudly at the harbour festival that every ship in port tooted back, and the town's windows rattled till midnight.
lore.legendary: Pulled the biggest ship in the world off a sandbank, then went home for a cup of tea.

lore.common: Parks in the marina and blocks everyone else's view of the sea.
lore.uncommon: Has so many shiny bits on its deck that the seagulls use it as a mirror.
lore.rare: Made such a big wave leaving the harbour that every little boat bobbed up and down.
lore.epic: Sailed into the harbour with fireworks for its birthday, and the whole town stayed up.
lore.legendary: Was so big that it brought its own little yacht along, and that one had a little yacht too.

lore.common: Is late on the coldest morning, then arrives early on the day you forget your shoes.
lore.uncommon: Pops out a little stop sign on its side, and every car has to wait.
lore.rare: Bounced over a speed bump so hard that every child on the back seat hit the ceiling.
lore.epic: Picked up every child in the county on the first snowy day, and nobody missed school.
lore.legendary: Drove so gently over the speed bumps for a whole term that the egg-and-spoon team practised on the back seat and never dropped one.

names.legendary: Lightning Lilly, Fastest Kid in Town

lore.common: Bashes you on the ankle every time you push off.
lore.uncommon: Folds up for the bus and then refuses to unfold.
lore.rare: Zoomed down the hill so fast that the pigeons had to jump out of the way.
lore.epic: Led a gang of scooters round the park, and every jogger stepped onto the grass.
lore.legendary: Scooted from one end of town to the other faster than the bus, and waited for it at the stop.

lore.common: Rings its bell at every corner, whether anyone is there or not.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled by pedal power alone, so the rider's legs are very strong.
lore.rare: Slipped through the busy market so quickly that it delivered a whole family before the bus.
lore.epic: Carried home so many shoppers on festival day that its bell wore out, and it had to shout ding instead.
lore.legendary: Pedalled up the steepest hill in the city with a piano in the back, and the passenger played it all the way up.

names.legendary: Tukko, Fastest Taxi in the City

lore.common: Putt-putts so loudly that you hear it three streets before it arrives.
lore.uncommon: Has only three wheels, so it leans round corners like a nervous bird.
lore.rare: Leaned so far round a corner on two wheels that the passengers shook hands with a fruit seller.
lore.epic: Carried a whole wedding party through the city, with the bride riding on the roof.
lore.legendary: Has driven every street in the biggest city a thousand times and still knows the quickest way to the beach.

lore.common: Rolls away from you the moment you put it on, so you have to grab the railing.
lore.uncommon: Has a rubber brake on one heel that most riders forget about until they reach the bottom of the hill.
lore.rare: Glided so smoothly down the promenade that the seagulls kept pace.
lore.epic: Raced down the seafront with a hundred others, and the ice cream sellers stepped back.
lore.legendary: Skated the whole length of the coast path in one day, and only fell over once, at the end.

lore.common: Wobbles so much that you hold onto the wall all the way round the rink.
lore.uncommon: Has four wheels and bright laces, and thinks it's very fashionable.
lore.rare: Spun round on one foot so fast that the disco lights got dizzy.
lore.epic: Started a roller disco in the car park, and the whole street came to skate.
lore.legendary: Danced so well at the roller disco that the mirror ball came down from the ceiling to join in.

lore.common: Rolls forward the moment you lean even a tiny bit, so you spill your coffee.
lore.uncommon: Glides along with no sound at all, so it sneaks up on pigeons.
lore.rare: Balanced on two wheels in a gale while everyone else blew over.
lore.epic: Led a city tour of fifty riders all in a line, and the tourists thought it was a parade.
lore.legendary: Went the whole length of the coast on one charge, then leaned forward one last time and rolled into the sea for a paddle.
